tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page canvas behind every card on the web dashboard and the iPhone app; the window behind the island menu bar. Dark-first: pure black, so the island and the page read as one object.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards on bg: the Now card, latest verdict, today timeline, week, sessions; iPhone grouped rows; the composer at rest. Separate it from bg with hairline, not a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised or nested layer inside a card: the composer while focused, popovers, the setup drawer, the correction popover, hover state of a row on surface-1.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Pressed rows, selected chips without colour, meter and ring tracks, the segmented-control thumb rail, keycap (Kbd) fill. Only ink and ink-2 may sit on it; never ink-3.

tokens.name: island
tokens.usage: The notch island fill on Mac (both themes: it must merge with the hardware notch) and the Live Activity / Dynamic Island backdrop. Solid, no glass, no gradient.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind the setup drawer, the lightbox for contact-sheet frames and iPhone sheets. Fades in on dur-medium, out at 0.65x.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: headings, body, voice lines, stats, button labels on neutral fills. Reads on bg, surface-1, surface-2 and surface-3. Contrast (text, needs 4.5:1): Dark 18.76 on bg, 15.55 on surface-1, 13.52 on surface-2, 11.29 on surface-3; Light 15.55 on bg, 17.40 on surface-1, 16.25 on surface-2, 14.60 on surface-3.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, timestamps, captions under stats, inactive tab labels, icons beside labels. Reads on bg, surface-1, surface-2 and surface-3. Contrast (text, needs 4.5:1): Dark 8.63 on bg, 7.15 on surface-1, 6.22 on surface-2, 5.19 on surface-3; Light 5.79 on bg, 6.48 on surface-1, 6.05 on surface-2, 5.44 on surface-3.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Faint text: composer placeholder, disabled labels, keyboard hints, chart axis labels. Reads on bg, surface-1 and surface-2 only (it fails on surface-3; use ink-2 there). Replaces the failing #767676 / #8C8C8C. Contrast (text, needs 4.5:1): Dark 6.49 on bg, 5.38 on surface-1, 4.68 on surface-2; Light 4.55 on bg, 5.10 on surface-1, 4.76 on surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill: tooltips and the snackbar, which invert the theme. Never on green (use on-accent) or red (use on-warn). Contrast (text, needs 4.5:1): Dark 18.76 on ink; Light 17.40 on ink.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px dividers and card edges: card borders on bg, list separators, the today-timeline rules. Depth comes from this, not from shadows. Not a component boundary (see hairline-strong).

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: 1px boundary of a control that has no fill of its own: unchecked checkbox and radio, the composer outline when it sits directly on bg, the unselected segmented control, the dashed absent ring outline. Meets 3:1 on bg, surface-1, surface-2 and surface-3. Contrast (mark, needs 3:1): Dark 3.39 on bg, 3.57 on surface-1, 3.45 on surface-2, 3.22 on surface-3; Light 3.40 on bg, 3.47 on surface-1, 3.43 on surface-2, 3.36 on surface-3.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: NVIDIA green, exact. Fill for the one primary button per view, the send button, the progress ring and meter on dark grounds, the selected tab indicator, the 2px now-line. At most 5% of chrome. Always paired with on-accent text. As a thin mark on light grounds it is only 2.41:1 on white, so light-theme rings and meters use on-task.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of accent buttons (pointer: fine only). Lighter in dark, deeper in light; on-accent still reads on it.

tokens.name: accent-press
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of accent buttons, together with scale 0.97 on dur-micro.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any green fill: primary button label, send arrow, the Done verdict pill, the contact-sheet badge. Always black, never white. Contrast (text, needs 4.5:1): Dark 8.71 on accent, 10.35 on accent-hover, 7.21 on accent-press; Light 8.71 on accent, 7.21 on accent-hover, 6.03 on accent-press.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Green text: links, 'On task 92%' figures, the active chip label, the honesty line's 'seen' number. Reads on bg, surface-1, surface-2, surface-3 and accent-wash. Light uses #477200 (green-700) because #4E7A00 fails on the wash (4.48). Contrast (text, needs 4.5:1): Dark 11.59 on bg, 9.60 on surface-1, 8.35 on surface-2, 6.97 on surface-3, 8.38 on accent-wash; Light 5.10 on bg, 5.71 on surface-1, 5.33 on surface-2, 4.79 on surface-3, 5.01 on accent-wash.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for a selected chip, the on-task streak pill, ::selection, the focused composer's send-area halo. Text on it is accent-ink or ink.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px :focus-visible outline with 2px offset on every focusable element, web and iPhone. Light uses green-600 because #76B900 is only 2.15:1 on the light page. Meets 3:1 on bg, surface-1, surface-2 and surface-3. Contrast (mark, needs 3:1): Dark 8.71 on bg, 7.22 on surface-1, 6.28 on surface-2, 5.24 on surface-3; Light 3.63 on bg, 4.06 on surface-1, 3.79 on surface-2, 3.41 on surface-3.

tokens.name: green-100
tokens.usage: Lightest green: celebration particles on dark, the bloom's hot centre in the reel title card. Never text.

tokens.name: green-200
tokens.usage: Pinch sparkles on dark grounds, confetti highlight. Never text.

tokens.name: green-300
tokens.usage: Pinch belly and highlight. Never text.

tokens.name: green-500
tokens.usage: Ramp anchor, identical to accent: Pinch body, claimed-vs-seen 'seen' bars on dark.

tokens.name: green-600
tokens.usage: Pinch shade; light-theme focus ring; 'seen' bars on light. A 3:1 mark on light grounds only. Contrast (mark, needs 3:1): Dark 5.17 on bg, 4.28 on surface-1, 3.72 on surface-2; Light 3.63 on bg, 4.06 on surface-1, 3.79 on surface-2.

tokens.name: green-700
tokens.usage: Green text on light grounds and washes (same value as light accent-ink).

tokens.name: green-800
tokens.usage: Pinch outline on light grounds; dark lines inside the mascot (mouth, antennae).

tokens.name: on-task
tokens.usage: Sample dot: filled circle. Also the session ring and meter fill, and 'seen' bars. Shape-coded: green and amber are identical under protanopia, so the circle shape carries the meaning. Contrast (mark, needs 3:1): Dark 8.71 on bg, 7.22 on surface-1, 6.28 on surface-2, 5.24 on surface-3; Light 3.63 on bg, 4.06 on surface-1, 3.79 on surface-2, 3.41 on surface-3.

tokens.name: on-task-ink
tokens.usage: Text naming on-task time: 'On task 92%', '1h 52m seen'. Reads on bg, surface-1, surface-2, surface-3 and accent-wash. Contrast (text, needs 4.5:1): Dark 11.59 on bg, 9.60 on surface-1, 8.35 on surface-2, 6.97 on surface-3, 8.38 on accent-wash; Light 5.10 on bg, 5.71 on surface-1, 5.33 on surface-2, 4.79 on surface-3, 5.01 on accent-wash.

tokens.name: partial
tokens.usage: Partial verdict mark: the half-filled circle glyph, meter fill between partAt and doneAt, amber ring for breaks. Light uses a deeper amber so the mark meets 3:1. Contrast (mark, needs 3:1): Dark 10.45 on bg, 8.66 on surface-1, 7.53 on surface-2, 6.29 on surface-3; Light 3.88 on bg, 4.34 on surface-1, 4.05 on surface-2, 3.64 on surface-3.

tokens.name: partial-ink
tokens.usage: Text for partial, idle and break states: 'Partly', 'Idle 4 min', the break countdown label. Reads on bg, surface-1, surface-2, surface-3 and partial-wash. Contrast (text, needs 4.5:1): Dark 13.02 on bg, 10.79 on surface-1, 9.38 on surface-2, 7.83 on surface-3, 9.67 on partial-wash; Light 5.05 on bg, 5.65 on surface-1, 5.27 on surface-2, 4.74 on surface-3, 5.04 on partial-wash.

tokens.name: partial-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for the Partly verdict pill and the break banner. Text on it is partial-ink or ink.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Red mark: phone and off-task dots, slacked meter fill, error icons. Never the accent, never a full red card. Text on a red fill is on-warn. Contrast (mark, needs 3:1): Dark 5.37 on bg, 4.45 on surface-1, 3.87 on surface-2, 3.23 on surface-3; Light 3.50 on bg, 3.91 on surface-1, 3.65 on surface-2, 3.28 on surface-3.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Red text: the noun in a nudge ('your phone'), error messages, 'Slacked'. Reads on bg, surface-1, surface-2, surface-3 and warn-wash. Contrast (text, needs 4.5:1): Dark 8.34 on bg, 6.91 on surface-1, 6.01 on surface-2, 5.02 on surface-3, 6.46 on warn-wash; Light 5.39 on bg, 6.04 on surface-1, 5.63 on surface-2, 5.06 on surface-3, 4.94 on warn-wash.

tokens.name: warn-wash
tokens.usage: 10% red tint behind the Slacked pill and an error row. Text on it is warn-ink or ink.

tokens.name: on-warn
tokens.usage: Text on a solid red fill (destructive button, phone badge). Black, because white is 3.91:1. Contrast (text, needs 4.5:1): Dark 5.37 on warn; Light 5.37 on warn.

tokens.name: idle
tokens.usage: Idle sample: hollow amber ring (2px). Same hue as partial; the ring shape tells them apart. Contrast (mark, needs 3:1): Dark 10.45 on bg, 8.66 on surface-1, 7.53 on surface-2, 6.29 on surface-3; Light 3.88 on bg, 4.34 on surface-1, 4.05 on surface-2, 3.64 on surface-3.

tokens.name: idle-ink
tokens.usage: Text for idle: 'Idle 3 min', 'On a break'. Same values as partial-ink. Contrast (text, needs 4.5:1): Dark 13.02 on bg, 10.79 on surface-1, 9.38 on surface-2, 7.83 on surface-3, 9.67 on partial-wash; Light 5.05 on bg, 5.65 on surface-1, 5.27 on surface-2, 4.74 on surface-3, 5.04 on partial-wash.

tokens.name: phone
tokens.usage: Phone sample: filled red rounded square. Same red as warn; the square shape carries it. Contrast (mark, needs 3:1): Dark 5.37 on bg, 4.45 on surface-1, 3.87 on surface-2, 3.23 on surface-3; Light 3.50 on bg, 3.91 on surface-1, 3.65 on surface-2, 3.28 on surface-3.

tokens.name: off-task
tokens.usage: Off-task sample: red square with a 45 degree hatch (repeating-linear-gradient 2px/2px). Replaces the retired #C8362B, which was indistinguishable from phone red. Contrast (mark, needs 3:1): Dark 5.37 on bg, 4.45 on surface-1, 3.87 on surface-2, 3.23 on surface-3; Light 3.50 on bg, 3.91 on surface-1, 3.65 on surface-2, 3.28 on surface-3.

tokens.name: absent
tokens.usage: Absent sample: 1.5px dashed grey ring; island wing when nobody is at the desk. Must be #A6A6A6 in the island. Contrast (mark, needs 3:1): Dark 8.63 on bg, 7.15 on surface-1, 6.22 on surface-2, 5.19 on surface-3; Light 4.06 on bg, 4.54 on surface-1, 4.24 on surface-2, 3.81 on surface-3.

tokens.name: absent-ink
tokens.usage: Text for absent: 'Away 6 min', 'No frames'. Reads on bg, surface-1, surface-2 and surface-3. Contrast (text, needs 4.5:1): Dark 8.63 on bg, 7.15 on surface-1, 6.22 on surface-2, 5.19 on surface-3; Light 5.79 on bg, 6.48 on surface-1, 6.05 on surface-2, 5.44 on surface-3.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Verdict alias: Done. The pill reads '✓ Done' as on-accent on accent, or on-task-ink on accent-wash; the mark (meter, dot) uses this. Contrast (mark, needs 3:1): Dark 8.71 on bg, 7.22 on surface-1, 6.28 on surface-2, 5.24 on surface-3; Light 3.63 on bg, 4.06 on surface-1, 3.79 on surface-2, 3.41 on surface-3.

tokens.name: partly
tokens.usage: Verdict alias: Partly. Pill '◐ Partly' in partial-ink on partial-wash. Contrast (mark, needs 3:1): Dark 10.45 on bg, 8.66 on surface-1, 7.53 on surface-2, 6.29 on surface-3; Light 3.88 on bg, 4.34 on surface-1, 4.05 on surface-2, 3.64 on surface-3.

tokens.name: slacked
tokens.usage: Verdict alias: Slacked. Pill '✕ Slacked' in warn-ink on warn-wash. Pinch stays green and supportive. Contrast (mark, needs 3:1): Dark 5.37 on bg, 4.45 on surface-1, 3.87 on surface-2, 3.23 on surface-3; Light 3.50 on bg, 3.91 on surface-1, 3.65 on surface-2, 3.28 on surface-3.

tokens.name: pinch-body
tokens.usage: Pinch's body and claws at every size from the 16pt wing to the 160pt celebration.

tokens.name: pinch-belly
tokens.usage: Belly patch and claw-tip highlight, 24pt and up.

tokens.name: pinch-shade
tokens.usage: Underside shade, inner claw, tail fan; 24pt and up.

tokens.name: pinch-outline
tokens.usage: 1.5px outline at 24pt and up: a bright rim on dark grounds, a deep outline on light grounds. Off at 16pt (silhouette only). Contrast (mark, needs 3:1): Dark 11.59 on bg, 9.60 on surface-1; Light 7.25 on bg, 8.12 on surface-1.

tokens.name: pinch-eye
tokens.usage: Dot eyes and pupils (black on green body). One white highlight per eye in pinch-shine. Contrast (mark, needs 3:1): Dark 8.71 on pinch-body; Light 8.71 on pinch-body.

tokens.name: pinch-shine
tokens.usage: Eye highlight dot; lens glass glint.

tokens.name: pinch-blush
tokens.usage: Cheek blush on celebrate and hello. Amber at 40%, never red.

tokens.name: pinch-spark
tokens.usage: Sparkles around Pinch on celebrate and connected; deeper on light so they stay visible on white.

tokens.name: pinch-lens
tokens.usage: Rim and handle of Pinch's detective magnifying lens. Contrast (mark, needs 3:1): Dark 14.59 on bg, 12.09 on surface-1; Light 5.79 on bg, 6.48 on surface-1.

tokens.name: pinch-lens-glow
tokens.usage: Lens glass while the camera is sampling (the lens is the camera-on indicator). Off = empty glass in the ground colour.

tokens.name: bloom
tokens.usage: Centre stop of the one allowed gradient, the celebration bloom: radial-gradient(closest-side, var(--bloom), transparent) at 1.6x Pinch's size, behind the verdict reveal and streak moments only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The live session timer in the Now card and the verdict reveal's count-up. Rounded numerals, tabular.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: One per page: the dashboard honesty line in the hero strip, onboarding titles.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles in sentence case: Now, Latest verdict, Today, This week, Sessions.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card and row titles: the session name, a plan block, a setup group.

styles.name: voice
styles.sample: You said drawing. I've seen your phone for 3 minutes.
styles.usage: Alibi's voice: Pinch's lines, the verdict sentence, the nightly report sentences. Same family as the UI; weight and size make it the voice.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Twenty-five minutes at the desk, camera on, laptop on Procreate the whole time.
styles.usage: Default reading text. In dark: line-height 1.6 and +0.01em tracking (tokens.css swaps --body-lh / --body-ls). Prose capped at 62ch.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines, timestamps, captions under stats, helper text. Usually in ink-2.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, field labels, pill text, tab labels. Sentence case only, never uppercase eyebrows. The web floor.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Single stats: on-task %, seen minutes, streak days. Rounded, tabular.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Keycaps (Kbd) and IDs only: session ids, file paths in setup. Never for labels or eyebrows. Tabular figures.

styles.name: island-wordmark
styles.usage: The island wordmark: SF Pro Heavy 12pt, tracking 1.6. The only uppercase text in the system.

styles.name: island-wing
styles.usage: Right wing countdown in live wings: SF Pro Rounded semibold, monospacedDigit, numericText(countsDown: true). Tabular figures.

styles.name: island-timer
styles.usage: Expanded island session timer: Rounded semibold, monospacedDigit, tracking -0.5. Tabular figures.

styles.name: island-title
styles.usage: Session title and alert headline in the expanded island, nudge and verdict alerts.

styles.name: island-voice
styles.sample: You said drawing. I've seen your phone for 3 minutes.
styles.usage: Pinch's line in nudge and verdict alerts and the drift line; the noun alone in warn-ink.

styles.name: island-body
styles.sample: What are you about to do?
styles.usage: Composer text and body copy in the expanded island; lineSpacing 3.

styles.name: island-secondary
styles.usage: Secondary island text at 60% white. The island floor is 11pt (badge digits only below that).

styles.name: ios-largetitle
styles.usage: iPhone screen titles: .largeTitle semibold (34/41 at the Large setting). Dynamic Type.

styles.name: ios-title
styles.usage: Section headers: .title2 semibold (22/28); .title3 semibold (20/25) for subsections.

styles.name: ios-headline
styles.usage: Row titles: .headline (17/22).

styles.name: ios-body
styles.sample: Synced from your Mac 2 min ago.
styles.usage: Body: .body (17/22); .subheadline (15/20) for dense rows.

styles.name: ios-footnote
styles.usage: Meta lines: .footnote (13/18).

styles.name: ios-caption
styles.usage: Labels and chip text: .caption semibold (12/16), sentence case.

styles.name: ios-stat
styles.usage: Stats: .title rounded semibold, monospacedDigit (28/34). Tabular figures.

styles.name: ios-timer
styles.usage: Today hero timer: 56pt rounded semibold, monospacedDigit, Text(timerInterval:). Tabular figures.

styles.name: la-title
styles.usage: Lock Screen Live Activity habit title: 15pt semibold.

styles.name: la-timer
styles.usage: Lock Screen countdown: 34pt rounded semibold, monospacedDigit, Text(timerInterval:countsDown:). Tabular figures.

styles.name: la-compact
styles.usage: Dynamic Island compact trailing timer: 14pt rounded semibold in a fixed 40pt frame. Tabular figures.

styles.name: la-expanded-center
styles.usage: Dynamic Island expanded centre line: 17pt semibold.

spacing.note: 4-based ladder. Card padding 24 web, 20 iPhone, 16 island; sections 48-72 apart; dashboard column max 880px, prose 62ch.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, dot-to-word gap, the tightest inline gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gap, gap between a stat and its caption, button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Island panel inner padding (12, so 16-radius inner cards stay concentric in the 28 shape); row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Island card padding; button horizontal padding; gaps inside a card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Web card padding; gap between dashboard cards; iPhone card padding is 20 (space-4 + space-1).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a card's header block and its body; hero strip padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between dashboard sections (minimum).

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Gap between dashboard sections (maximum); top of page above the hero strip.

radius.note: One concentric ladder: inner radius = outer radius minus padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, inline tags, keycaps, sample dots that are squares (phone).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, popover items, contact-sheet frames at thumbnail size.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards on the web and inside the island; the correction popover.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The composer, iPhone sheets, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The island's open shape (with space-3 padding, inner 16 cards stay concentric).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, verdict pills, streak badge, the round send button, status capsules.

shadow.note: Hairlines over shadows. Two shadows exist, both for floating layers.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The only web shadow: floating layers only (popovers, the correction popover, toasts, the drawer, the lightbox). Cards use hairline instead.

tokens.name: shadow-island
tokens.usage: The open island and its alerts (SwiftUI: black .5 r6 y2 plus black .35 r24 y12). None when collapsed; the web NotchIsland preview uses the same value.

duration.note: Exits run at 0.65x the enter duration with no bounce. Frequent actions get the shortest values.

tokens.name: dur-micro
tokens.usage: Press scale, toggles, colour changes, focus ring.

tokens.name: dur-small
tokens.usage: Tooltips, popovers, chip select, hover lift.

tokens.name: dur-medium
tokens.usage: Toasts, card expand, content blur-in, stagger items (40ms apart, max 6).

tokens.name: dur-drawer
tokens.usage: Setup drawer and sheets (with ease-drawer); exit at 0.65x.

tokens.name: dur-reveal
tokens.usage: Verdict count-up and meter fill (scaleX) in the verdict reveal.

tokens.name: dur-celebrate
tokens.usage: Pinch's celebrate clip and the claw confetti burst; the whole moment is skippable and capped at 2.6s.

easing.note: ease-out for enter/exit, ease-in-out for on-screen movement, linear only for time.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for every enter and exit: fades, popovers, blur-ins. Never use ease-in on UI.

tokens.name: ease-drawer
tokens.usage: Drawer and sheet slides.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things moving while on screen (FLIP of a section, ring arc start without a spring).

spring.note: Six springs shared by web, island and iPhone (Motion.md). CSS values are linear() simulations of the SwiftUI springs; -dur is the settle time.

tokens.name: spring-micro
tokens.usage: Toggles, chip select, sample dot recolour. SwiftUI .spring(duration: 0.25, bounce: 0.0). CSS: transition: transform var(--spring-micro-dur) var(--spring-micro); falls back to ease-out where linear() is unsupported, and to ease under reduced motion.

tokens.name: spring-micro-dur
tokens.usage: Settle time of spring-micro (376ms, longer than the perceived 250ms). Pair it with spring-micro; 150ms under reduced motion.

tokens.name: spring-snappy
tokens.usage: Popovers, island wings, inner island content, composer send, digit tickers. SwiftUI .spring(duration: 0.35, bounce: 0.15). CSS: transition: transform var(--spring-snappy-dur) var(--spring-snappy); falls back to ease-out where linear() is unsupported, and to ease under reduced motion.

tokens.name: spring-snappy-dur
tokens.usage: Settle time of spring-snappy (484ms, longer than the perceived 350ms). Pair it with spring-snappy; 150ms under reduced motion.

tokens.name: spring-smooth
tokens.usage: Every close and collapse, sheets, ring start. No bounce into the notch. SwiftUI .spring(duration: 0.5, bounce: 0.0). CSS: transition: transform var(--spring-smooth-dur) var(--spring-smooth); falls back to ease-out where linear() is unsupported, and to ease under reduced motion.

tokens.name: spring-smooth-dur
tokens.usage: Settle time of spring-smooth (686ms, longer than the perceived 500ms). Pair it with spring-smooth; 150ms under reduced motion.

tokens.name: spring-island
tokens.usage: Notch to panel open (island bloom). SwiftUI .spring(duration: 0.45, bounce: 0.2). CSS: transition: transform var(--spring-island-dur) var(--spring-island); falls back to ease-out where linear() is unsupported, and to ease under reduced motion.

tokens.name: spring-island-dur
tokens.usage: Settle time of spring-island (619ms, longer than the perceived 450ms). Pair it with spring-island; 150ms under reduced motion.

tokens.name: spring-bouncy
tokens.usage: Nudge alert drop, verdict pill, streak bump, sample dot pop. SwiftUI .spring(duration: 0.5, bounce: 0.3). CSS: transition: transform var(--spring-bouncy-dur) var(--spring-bouncy); falls back to ease-out where linear() is unsupported, and to ease under reduced motion.

tokens.name: spring-bouncy-dur
tokens.usage: Settle time of spring-bouncy (720ms, longer than the perceived 500ms). Pair it with spring-bouncy; 150ms under reduced motion.

tokens.name: spring-celebrate
tokens.usage: Pinch only (hop, clap). Never on UI structure. SwiftUI .spring(duration: 0.6, bounce: 0.4). CSS: transition: transform var(--spring-celebrate-dur) var(--spring-celebrate); falls back to ease-out where linear() is unsupported, and to ease under reduced motion.

tokens.name: spring-celebrate-dur
tokens.usage: Settle time of spring-celebrate (1003ms, longer than the perceived 600ms). Pair it with spring-celebrate; 150ms under reduced motion.
